config.advertiser_summary: The advertiser sells high-powered blenders designed primarily for home use, though they also have commercial applications. They are currently running a temporary promotional offer.

assumptions: Price not given; assumed $60 for a 'unknown' product.
No target CPA/ROAS or margin given; assumed 55% gross margin (typical for home). Give a target CPA to replace this.
Target CPA = 70% of max affordable CAC ($60 x 55% margin x 1.1 orders = $36.30).

pricing.rationale: Acquisition goal with no conversion history: pay per click. Max CPC = target CPA $25.41 x click-to-purchase rate (0.6%-2.1% for home). Clicks are observable without trusting a pixel, so both sides can verify billing.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded; until then Disco can't predict conversion rate for this brand.

budget.pacing: even daily pacing; pause a host if CPA > 2.0x target after 150 clicks

allocations.rationale: score 0.47 -> relative fit x1.40 on CTR/CVR; max bid $0.43 (break-even at target CPA), start at 70%

warnings: No budget given: recommending $150, the smallest budget that buys 300 clicks per host.

phases.name: learning
phases.rule: bid = start bid per host (70% of break-even); pacing adjustment only
phases.why: stable bids so measured CTR/CVR aren't confounded by bid changes

phases.name: enhanced_cpc
phases.until: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded; until then Disco can't predict conversion rate for this brand.
phases.rule: bid = start bid x conversion_likelihood x pacing, clamped to [floor, max bid]
phases.why: spend more on shoppers who look likely to buy, never above break-even

phases.name: target_cpa
phases.rule: Disco bids automatically to hit $25.41 CPA
phases.why: only once Disco can predict this brand's conversion rate

adjustments.reason: Bid higher when the shopper looks like a high converter: their persona match for this campaign vs the host's average shopper (from the serve-time persona posterior).
Under-delivering vs the daily plan -> bid up a little; over-delivering -> bid down.

bid_strategy.rationale: Start below break-even and fixed so the first two weeks measure the hosts, not the bidder; then bid per shopper within a hard ceiling (max CPC = target CPA x CVR), so a single click can never cost more than it's expected to earn.
